Start: ^[The historian stands near the edge of the square, their gaze fixed on the distant forest, a lantern flickering faintly in their hand.]
^[[Historian]]: Ah, a newcomer. Few wanderers find their way to this forgotten place. What brings you here?
Option_Passing: ^[[Historian]]: Passing through? No one merely passes through here. This town has a way of pulling people in. Whether you realize it or not, you’re here for a reason.
Option_Stories: ^[[You]]: I’ve heard stories about this place.
^[[Historian]]: Stories? Ah, yes, the kind that warn of shadows and curses, no doubt. There’s truth in them, though not always the kind people want to hear.
Option_Concern: ^[[Historian]]: Perhaps not. But secrets don’t stay hidden here for long. This town has a way of drawing them out.
AskAboutSparks: ^[[Historian]]: I assume, if you’ve spoken to anyone in this town, you’ve heard about the sparks?
Option_Heard: ^[[Historian]]: Then you know they’re more than just flickering lights. Some say they guide the lost. Others say they lead only to ruin.
^[[Historian]]: And yet, they appear without fail, deep in the forest, as if waiting for someone.
Option_WhatSparks: ^[[Historian]]: Glowing orbs, flickering in the darkest parts of the woods. Some say they’re a guide, others a trap. Whatever they are, they’ve become part of this place’s curse.
AskDecision: ^[[Historian]]: So, tell me, what would you do if you saw one?
Option_Follow: ^[[Historian]]: Brave, or reckless. Perhaps both. Light may guide, but it also exposes. Be ready for what it reveals.
Option_Avoid: ^[[Historian]]: Perhaps wise, but remember here, everything eventually finds you. The sparks are no exception.
Option_Unsure: ^[[Historian]]: Caution suits those who tread these grounds. If the time comes, trust your instincts. They may be your only guide.
Lantern_Gift: ^[[Historian]]: Here. If you plan to linger, you’ll need this.
^The historian hands you their lantern, its glass etched with strange, swirling patterns. The glow is faint but steady.

c-0: ^[[Historian]]: It’s old, but it’s served me well. May it do the same for you.
^[[Historian]]: Remember, light can guide, but it can also reveal. Be sure you’re ready to see what lies ahead.

End: ^[The historian nods, their lantern casting flickering shadows as they step away into the growing dusk.]
